title: Minecraft 2014 yilda 2,5 milliard dollarga sotilgan

scenes.text: 2014 yilda Microsoft Minecraft o'yini egasi Mojang studiyasini 2,5 milliard dollarga sotib oldi.
O'yinni shved dasturchisi Markus Persson 2009 yilda shaxsiy loyiha sifatida boshlagan.
scenes.keywords: programmer typing code at night home desk

scenes.text: Birinchi versiya xom edi, lekin u uni darhol chiqarib, o'yinchilar bilan birga yaxshilab bordi.
scenes.keywords: young people playing video game on computer

scenes.text: Bugun Minecraft tarixdagi eng ko'p sotilgan video o'yin hisoblanadi.
Mukammallikni kutmang: ishlaydigan narsani chiqaring va yaxshilab boring.
scenes.keywords: building blocks stacking hands close up

description:
2014 yilda Microsoft Minecraft o'yinini yaratgan Mojang studiyasini 2,5 milliard dollarga sotib oldi. O'yinni Markus Persson 2009 yilda boshlagan va bugun u tarixdagi eng ko'p sotilgan video o'yin hisoblanadi.

Bu saboq sizga kerakmi? Izohda bitta so'z bilan yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-09: TRUE (one edit: 'bo'sh vaqtida' replaced by 'shaxsiy loyiha sifatida', because sources call it a personal project started in May 2009 while Persson had a day job at jAlbum, not explicitly 'spare time'). Microsoft acquisition of Mojang announced 15 Sep 2014 for $2.5 billion, closed Nov 2014, https://news.microsoft.com/2014/09/15/minecraft-to-join-microsoft/ ; https://www.pbs.org/newshour/economy/minecraft-to-join-microsoft-in-2-5-billion-deal ; https://www.engadget.com/2014/11/06/microsoft-completes-acquisition-of-minecraft-studio/ ; Development began May 2009 by Markus Persson, first public (Classic) version 17 May 2009 (the formal Alpha phase came 30 June 2010), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Development_of_Minecraft:_Java_Edition ; best-selling video game ever: passed 300 million copies on 15 Oct 2023, Guinness lists 350 million as of April 2025, https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/best-selling-video-game
